author: claude
summary: Task 005 of the voices-variants-round2 plan: catalog page CLASS/GENDER/AGE filters become compact MultiSelects (task 004's new primitive) sourced from voice-taxonomy.json instead of hand-duplicated arrays, plus a separate free-form tag filter. OR-within-facet, AND-across-facets. Also fixes 3 stale tests in unrelated files (VoicesTabContent.test.tsx, VoicesPage.test.tsx) broken by task 002's catalog-card action consolidation.

files.change: Fixed one label drift: gender 'not-applicable' was 'Not applicable', voice-taxonomy.json says 'Not applicable (non-human)'. Now byte-identical to the JSON for class/gender/age.

CLASS_OPTIONS/GENDER_OPTIONS/AGE_OPTIONS now derive from getSection('class'/'gender'/'age')?.values (the taxonomy mirror) instead of hardcoded arrays. Added a tagFilterOptions memo (dedupe+sort of live VoiceMetadata.tags). Wired tagFilter/tagOptions through to useVoicesData and VoicesTabHeader.
classFilter/genderFilter/ageFilter changed from string to string[]; added tagFilter/setTagFilter (string[]).
Filter predicates changed from single-value equality to array-based OR-within-facet (classFilter.includes(...) etc.), plus a new matchesTags predicate. Combination stays AND across facets.
Replaced the three CLASS/GENDER/AGE toggle-button rows with three compact MultiSelects in one row, plus a fourth MultiSelect for the free-form tag filter, visually separated by a divider.
Fixed a test broken by task 002 (Set as App Default moved from a direct VoiceCatalogCard button into its overflow menu) -- opens the kebab first now.
Fixed 2 tests broken by task 002 for the same reason (Set as App Default / Delete moved into the overflow menu) -- both now open the kebab first.

flow_impact: Sixth task landed in the voices-variants-round2 plan. Full frontend/src/pages/Voices + frontend/src/hooks + frontend/src/pages/VoiceLab + frontend/src/components/forms suites green (629 tests). Remaining critical path: tasks 007-009 (Voice Lab tab-IA collapse), then 010 (spec sync).
